requirements.title: Machine-readable implementation status
requirements.notes: Registry and validation test are implemented; exact-head CI evidence is required before VERIFIED.

requirements.title: Agent operating contract
requirements.notes: Agent.md now identifies the payroll registry, status semantics, tagging rules, tenant scope, and deferred foundation scope.

requirements.title: Tenant-scoped payroll actions
requirements.notes: Payroll period, payslip, overtime, loan, deduction, access, calendar, schedule and archive actions now resolve/create records under authenticated tenant scope; exact-head CI/security evidence still required before VERIFIED.

requirements.title: Payroll RBAC remains server-authoritative
requirements.notes: Existing requirePayrollAccess enforcement is preserved; exact-head regression evidence still required for VERIFIED.

requirements.title: Separate compensation basis, pay frequency, and attendance policy
requirements.notes: Calculation policy is now explicit, but persisted employee data still overloads legacy SalaryType and does not yet independently persist pay frequency/attendance policy.

requirements.title: Effective-dated employee payroll configuration
requirements.notes: Requires Prisma schema migration, backfill strategy, admin UI, and historical snapshot design.

requirements.title: Historical configuration integrity
requirements.notes: Paid-period lock exists; finalized revision/correction model is not yet complete.

requirements.title: Effective-dated schedules
requirements.notes: Effective range and overlap checks exist and schedule actions are tenant-hardened; exact-head acceptance evidence remains pending.

requirements.title: Attendance-derived payable time
requirements.notes: Calculation consumes payable status, lateness, undertime, night differential, rest day and holiday context through an explicit policy.

requirements.title: Auditable attendance corrections
requirements.notes: Original and adjusted JSON plus review status exist; end-to-end verification is outside the current foundation tranche.

requirements.title: Only approved overtime is payable
requirements.notes: Payroll refresh is tenant-scoped and filters APPROVED overtime.

requirements.title: Deterministic calculation engine
requirements.notes: Pure explicit-policy calculation path and deterministic regression test are implemented; exact-head CI pending.

requirements.title: Explicit calculation policy
requirements.notes: Calculation multipliers/hours are explicit policy inputs. The legacy wrapper is intentionally DEFERRED until effective-dated policy persistence exists and is not labeled as current law.

requirements.title: Non-negative rounded payroll totals
requirements.notes: Engine clamps basic/net pay and rounds money; exact-head CI pending.

requirements.title: Payroll-period deductions
requirements.notes: Draft-only normal maintenance is implemented and tenant-hardened.

requirements.title: Loan/cash advance repayment integrity
requirements.notes: Repayments are tenant-scoped, capped, and applied only when finalized payroll is marked paid; exact-head concurrency evidence still required for VERIFIED.

requirements.title: Expanded payroll lifecycle
requirements.notes: Current enum is DRAFT/FINALIZED/PAID. Expansion requires schema migration and coordinated UI/action changes.

requirements.title: Finalization validation
requirements.notes: Tenant-scoped payslip-count and DRAFT checks plus audit exist; exact-head test pending.

requirements.title: Immutable finalized/paid evidence with correction path
requirements.notes: PAID is locked from recalculation; controlled FINALIZED reopen/archive behavior remains until the complete revision/reversal model is implemented.

requirements.title: Effective-dated Philippine statutory rule sets
requirements.notes: Authoritative tables/effective dates and persistence model must be verified before production values are represented as current law.

requirements.title: Statutory rule snapshot
requirements.notes: Depends on PAY-STAT-001 and payroll revision snapshot model.

requirements.title: Idempotent payroll financial posting
requirements.notes: Finance posting contract and idempotency identity still need implementation.

requirements.title: Payroll finance outbox/retry/reconciliation
requirements.notes: Depends on finance posting contract.

requirements.title: Payroll expense/liability traceability
requirements.notes: Depends on finalized payroll revision model and Financial Engine mapping.

requirements.title: Tenant date-filtered payroll reports
requirements.notes: Existing report surfaces exist; acceptance against revised payroll/finance model remains pending.

requirements.title: Employee payslip self-service
requirements.notes: Existing employee portal/payslip surfaces exist; revised release/correction acceptance remains pending.

requirements.title: Employee mobile attendance UX
requirements.notes: Existing employee attendance features exist; revised UX acceptance is outside the current foundation tranche.
